description: This PHP source file 'execDashboard.php' is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It initializes and renders a dashboard interface for test execution, managing test plans, platforms, builds, user rights, and GUI configuration. It includes functions for argument initialization, rights setup, GUI setup, and context retrieval from session and request variables.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for the dashboard, retrieving test plan, project, build, and platform info from session and request variables.

methods.name: initializeRights
methods.description: Creates a rights object indicating user permissions for executing, deleting, editing test case notes, and managing test executions within a specific test project and plan.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI configuration object with test plan, build, platform info, custom fields, and REST API data based on provided arguments and database info.

methods.name: getContextFromGlobalScope
methods.description: Retrieves execution context information such as build and platform IDs from session variables or request parameters, using form tokens for session scoping.
